hero.title: Events feel easier with the right support.
hero.description: SK Event Hire provides quality event equipment and practical planning help for celebrations across Melbourne and Victoria.
hero.imageAlt: SK Event Hire team preparing event furniture

story.title: How SK Event Hire began
paragraphs: SK Event Hire was created to make event hire clearer, calmer and more dependable. We combine a carefully maintained product range with practical advice, local knowledge and reliable logistics.
Our role is simple: help customers choose confidently, prepare every item properly and make delivery, setup and collection easier to understand.
story.quoteSmall: Clear advice, honest communication and equipment that arrives ready.

promise.title: What customers can expect
promise.description: Simple standards guide every product, quotation and event.
standards: Every piece is washed, inspected and packed for the event.
Practical updates from quotation to final collection.
Delivery and collection windows planned around your venue.
Itemised products, labour, transport and optional extras.
Friendly people who care for your venue and occasion.

process.title: The way we work
process.description: Clear steps from your first idea to final collection.
steps: Advice based on venue, guests and event style.
Flexible options for different events and budgets.
Clear quotes, choices and next steps.

venues.title: Practical planning for real venues
venues.description: Every venue has its own access, surfaces, timing and weather considerations. We plan the details before event day.
venues.quote: ✓ We document important venue and setup details in your quotation.

team.title: Meet the people behind your event
team.description: One connected team plans, prepares and delivers your hire.
team.note: ✓ Clear ownership from enquiry to collection, with one connected event record.

localKnowledge.title: Local knowledge across Melbourne
localKnowledge.description: Our delivery planning is shaped by Melbourne venues, access conditions and real travel times.

points.title: Venue-aware logistics
points.subtitle: Access, surfaces and timing checked early.

responsibility.title: Hire, reuse and care
responsibility.description: Reusable event equipment works best when it is selected thoughtfully, maintained carefully and transported responsibly.
items: Packed to reduce marks and damage.
responsibility.quote: Better preparation supports longer product life and more reliable events.
responsibility.imageAlt: Equipment being loaded carefully for delivery

final.title: Tell us what you’re planning.
final.description: Share your date, location, guest count and priorities. We’ll help you build a clear hire plan.
